split_policy: within-person, disjoint sessions, strictly increasing train/dev/holdout windows
reference_access: scorer only; no case object or reference field reaches provider
primary_metric: mean(choice_match, core_reason_phrase_coverage); choice_match alone when reason rubric is empty
weighting: equal users, equal sessions within each user, equal items within each session
strongest_baseline: maximum aggregate primary mean among B0/B1/B2 on the common completed four-arm cohort; tie order B0,B1,B2
missing_policy: report each failure/missing call; exclude incomplete four-arm cases from paired estimate; preserve full denominator

bootstrap.unit: hierarchical paired user then conversation session

future_required_extensions: real participant consent and preregistered pilot thresholds
